data.gender_notes: Josafina is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew name Yo'safat, meaning 'God has healed', or the Greek name Iosaphē, meaning 'God has saved'. Josafina is a popular name among Christians, particularly in honor of Saint Josaphat (1581-1623), a Ukrainian monk and bishop. The name Josafina carries the meaning “God's healing” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Josafina usually hope their child will grow to embody god's healing and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Josafina total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_latin.meaning: Feminine form of Joseph, derived from Hebrew name Yosef, meaning God will add, a symbol of divine providence.
in_latin.long_meaning: Josaphina, the feminine form of Joseph, is a name derived from the Hebrew name Yosef, meaning God will add. This name symbolizes divine providence, emphasizing God's role in guiding and adding to our lives. In the context of the early Christian church, the name Joseph is significant, as Joseph of Arimathea is mentioned in the New Testament as the one who provided the tomb for Jesus' burial (Matthew 27:57-60). The name Josaphina reflects the Christian tradition of seeking divine guidance and provision.
